mechanism_narrative: Rising GDP indicates strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not higher when GDP rises (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in unemployment signals economic weakness, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Returns are positive when unemployment rises sharply.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment with high FEDFUNDS indicates inflation control, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when FEDFUNDS are high and UNRATE is low.

mechanism_narrative: High FEDFUNDS in a tightening cycle predict lower returns.
failure_condition: Returns are positive when FEDFUNDS exceed 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing industrial production boosts economic growth, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: Returns are not higher with rising industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts indicate weaker demand, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: Returns are positive when housing starts fall below 500.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales with low interest rates boost consumer spending, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when RSAFS rises and FEDFUNDS are low.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment predicts a strong economy, leading to positive returns.
failure_condition: Returns are not higher when unemployment is low.
